lines.text: 3 in 4 Americans live near a Dollar General. Here's why.
lines.say: Three in four Americans live near a Dollar General. Here's why.

lines.text: About 75% of Americans live within 5 miles of one. That's the model: small, cheap stores, close to you.
lines.say: About seventy-five percent of Americans live within five miles of one. That's the model: small, cheap stores, close to you.

lines.text: In fiscal 2025, Dollar General sold $42.7 billion of stuff, and 82% was consumables like food and paper towels.
lines.say: In fiscal twenty twenty-five, Dollar General sold forty-two point seven billion dollars of stuff, and eighty-two percent was consumables, like food and paper towels.

scene.label: Share of sales from consumables, FY2025

lines.text: Consumables keep you coming back. Traffic is the product.
lines.say: Consumables keep you coming back. Traffic is the product.

lines.text: Out of every $10 you spend, $6.93 pays for the goods. $3.07 is gross profit.
lines.say: Out of every ten dollars you spend, six dollars and ninety-three cents pays for the goods. Three dollars and seven cents is gross profit.

lines.text: After rent, wages and other costs, about 52 cents is operating profit.
lines.say: After rent, wages and other costs, about fifty-two cents is operating profit.

lines.text: More stores, more sales: $27.8 billion in fiscal 2019, $42.7 billion in fiscal 2025.
lines.say: More stores, more sales: twenty-seven point eight billion in fiscal twenty nineteen, forty-two point seven billion in fiscal twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: The takeaway: Dollar General wins on being close, not on being fancy.
lines.say: The takeaway: Dollar General wins on being close, not on being fancy.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: How Dollar General makes money: 3 in 4 live within 5 miles
post.ig:
3 in 4 Americans live within 5 miles of a Dollar General. Here's why.
Fiscal 2025: $42.7 billion in sales, 82% of it consumables like food and paper goods.
Out of every $10 spent, about $3.07 is gross profit and about 52 cents is operating profit.
Sales grew from $27.8 billion (FY2019) to $42.7 billion (FY2025).
Sources: Dollar General FY2025 10-K and earnings release.
